notes: Built by visually reviewing the mid-clip frame of all 52 shot candidates from the R24/R23 run (the widest candidate pool, before the shooter-origin-distance gate existed). A candidate was labeled true only when the goal/box was visible with genuine attacking action; labeled false when the frame showed open midfield play (often with a center-circle or halfway-line landmark clearly visible, confirming deep position regardless of camera zoom). 14 of 52 were labeled true. Source clips: output/full_r24/merged_clips (worker). Timestamps are global match time (mm:ss from filename).
